scope: Persistent owner-scoped brand view across workspace lists and new-work defaults
behavior: Sidebar Brand view stores a selected owned brand or All brands in D1 preferences. Existing accounts default to All brands.
Saved preference follows the account; explicit brand URL parameters and legacy brand/project entry links override the default without rewriting it.
Chats/history, full report library, projects, workflow catalog/runs, files, pitches, monitoring rules and overview previews respect explicit brand associations.
New research, pristine chat, new project/workflow/pitch/manual-monitor forms and new context uploads receive current/captured brand defaults.
Open drafts and saved record details retain their original context when the list view changes. Saved report/chat/workflow/pitch inputs are not globally rewritten.
Brand directory, reusable agency credentials, billing, developer access, settings and the all-brands monitoring toggle remain account-wide.
Older unassociated items remain in All brands; matching names never create associations. Selected-brand overview counts cover all saved reports while previews retain existing latest-100 bounds.
Deleting a selected brand clears its nullable preference. Manual rules retain context/pause state and detach the deleted profile association.

validation.workerAPI: Actual Worker/D1 checks cover persistence/isolation, invalid/foreign IDs, CSRF/unauthenticated/developer writes, settings and snapshot preservation, deletion and manual monitor associations
validation.dom: 11 actual Workspace/child-component tests in Happy DOM with fixture HTTP and unrelated session-control stub: cross-page filters, reload, Back/URL scope, unknown IDs, full counts, direct record views, draft preservation and failed-save recovery
validation.policy: Same-name identity separation, all-list scopes, preserved full counts, new-work context copying and URL/grid/All-brands state
validation.liveBrowser: No authenticated Edge/browser walkthrough claimed; DOM tests do not establish pixel layout.
validation.cleanInstall: Passed isolated npm 11.19.0 Linux x64 npm ci dry-run, without node_modules; restored two pre-existing optional WASM lock records removed by the Windows test-dependency install.

migration: 0016 adds one nullable reference to preferences. Generated ADD COLUMN SQL was corrected before publication to retain ON DELETE SET NULL from the schema.
theme: Existing styles only; no CSS changes
limits: A brand view is a filter/default, not a team permission boundary.
Explicit URL scope overrides the stored default. Other open tabs/devices update on reload, not realtime sync.
Existing drafts keep their context, so their explicit brand can differ from the current list filter.
Unassociated legacy items need explicit organization before appearing in a brand view.
rollback: Revert source to v22 while retaining the nullable column and saved preference. V22 settings updates preserve this additional column.
